frontier_selector.why: The presence of right breast erythema and pain, a 5 cm × 8 cm area of erythema and induration, and elevated leukocyte count strongly support Puerperal mastitis.

support_spans: A 35-year-old woman presented 11 weeks postpartum with right breast erythema and pain
5 cm × 8 cm area of erythema and induration on the medial aspect of the right breast
milky, nonpurulent discharge was easily expressed from both breasts
excessive amount of milk despite attempts to wean
Slightly heterogeneous appearance of the pituitary gland without evidence of discrete mass or lesion
contradict_spans: No recurrent headaches or visual changes were reported
